name: wa-gnome
description: WhatsApp Web desktop wrapper with native GNOME integration (tray, background notifications, autostart)
author: Gabriel Agostinho

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.desktop:install: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron . --install-desktop-entry
scripts.dist:appimage: npm run check && umask 022 && electron-builder --linux AppImage
scripts.dist:deb: npm run check && umask 022 && electron-builder --linux deb
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && umask 022 && electron-builder --linux dir
